audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's own defect list flags it: Karma wins 44.23% over 104 games, yet the chart handed Karma six of seven stages. On top of that the two layers disagreed on six rows — full-layer sides read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Akali/Skill/Akali while content win[] read Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Akali/Karma.
audit.why: Karma's edge is real but it is confined to levels 1-5: Five Point Strike reaches 550 and costs 110 mana at rank 1 against Karma's 950-range Inner Flame, and Twilight Shroud does not exist at level 1. From 6 onward Perfect Execution (120/90/60s) plus Shroud untargetability inverts it — Karma's W tether and E shield are both single-target spells that Shroud makes uncastable, and an enchanter does not out-scale an assassin in a duel.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma / Karma / Karma / Karma / Akali / Akali / Akali across both layers, with every why rewritten to match its verdict. This matches the 44.23% win rate instead of contradicting it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text said Karma's poke and wave control "edges her out in a scaling war" at two-plus items.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is 60s at rank 3 and executes below a threshold; Twilight Shroud renders Akali unselectable by spells and attacks, which blanks both of Karma's targeted abilities (W 675 tether, E 800 shield). The scaling war does not go Karma's way; her late value is peel.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[3].text and the content late/mid text around peel and vision instead of out-scaling. Spike ladder kept at four: pre-6 poke window, Perfect Execution at 6, her first item, the 60s-R late game.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Perfect Execution's execute threshold, and Assassin's Mark being an auto-attack reset that telegraphs the combo.
audit.why: Riot's text: Perfect Execution's recast "executes all enemies she strikes", so a health bar that looks survivable is not. Assassin's Mark rings the target on spell damage and empowers her next attack with bonus range — the wind-up is the tell, not the ability cast. Karma's W also reveals the target, which is the one clean answer to a shroud exit.
audit.corrected: Execute threshold stated in dontsFull[0].d and the late text; the W reveal-and-root on the Shroud exit stated in dosFull[1].d and breakdown.late; real cooldowns (Shroud 20-16s, Shuriken Flip 16-10s, R 120/90/60s) put into breakdown.cooldowns, which previously held no digit.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t told the reader to "add anti-heal early into his sustain".
audit.why: Nothing in Akali's kit text in the kit file describes healing. I will not assert sustain I cannot source, and the pronoun was wrong regardless.
audit.corrected: Replaced the anti-heal clause with the penetration line rather than keeping an unsourced claim with the pronoun patched.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nine fields called Akali "he/his"; two bullet bodies were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles; the content mid text hedged with "generally".
audit.why: Akali is she/her per champ-gender.js. Bled bodies contradict their own titles.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed everywhere lint flagged, both bled bodies replaced with content matching their titles, and the hedge removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.suspectNames flags wants.foe[1] "Use Twilight Shroud" as a probable wrong ability name.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is Akali's real W name in the kit file. This is a false positive from the near-miss matcher.
